plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to lower concentration.

conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on less volatile assets, accepting lower potential upside for reduced drawdown risk.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration.
Sell SMH to remove a weak position.
Reduce exposure in leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to lower overall risk.
Initiate a new position in ANET, a strong scanner setup.
This plan balances risk reduction with selective growth opportunities.
Focuses on maintaining a risk-first approach to growth.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name, aiming for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to slightly reduce income concentration.
Sell SMH to exit a weak position.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and adds an inverse leveraged ETF, accepting substantially higher risk and potential for rapid, large losses.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.

Add SPY to provide a stable broad market component.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI and broad index ETFs. It cuts all leverage and high-beta names, aiming for low drawdown and reliable, though variable, income.
